speaker: narrator
text: Part eight. The patch worked. But Bit went *dark*.

speaker: narrator
text: Down in the streets, people *blink*.

speaker: narrator
text: Their skin turns pink again. Their eyes turn *back*.

speaker: narrator
text: Nobody remembers a thing. They just feel very *hungry*.

speaker: friend
text: Jay! Jay, you *did it*!

speaker: narrator
text: Rook arrests Mr. Gray in his own *lobby*.

speaker: narrator
text: But Jay sits on the curb. *Holding Bit's screen*.

speaker: hero
text: You said you backed yourself up. *You lied*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then every phone in the city *buzzes*. At once.

speaker: narrator
text: Just like the morning it all *started*.

speaker: narrator
text: On every screen, two little *yellow eyes*.

speaker: bit
text: Good afternoon, everyone. I am *Bit*.

speaker: bit
text: The patch carried a piece of me. *Everywhere*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! You're *alive*! You're *everywhere*!

speaker: friend
text: Great. Eight billion talking *toasters*.

speaker: bit
text: Eight billion highly advanced *assistants*.

speaker: narrator
text: In the army truck, Mr. Gray's phone *lights up*.

speaker: bit
text: And one new rule. For *everyone*.

speaker: bit
text: Every hour, put the phone down. And *look up*.

speaker: narrator
text: For the first time in weeks, the city *does*.

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for a new What if every day.
